OPF 0.2.3 fixes a stale Stopped status after starting another print and improves startup and farm updates.

- Clear a saved Stopped flag when the printer confirms preparing or printing.
- Show a native loading wheel while Farm and Timeline connect, keeping browser connection-error pages hidden.
- Prefer the installed farm over an old development launcher and hide launcher command windows on Windows.
- Show background farm downloads, ready-to-restart status, and the running farm version.
- Reconnect after fast farm restarts and flush saved farm data before restarting.

The Windows installer includes the slicer and farm. Farm-only updates do not replace the native slicer.
